events.verdict: Mann (LAC) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Powell (LAC) and Booker (PHX) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound.
Jones (PHX) is not established in a legal guarding position in Harden's (LAC) path when he initiates the illegal contact attempting to draw an offensive foul.
Dunn (PHX) jumps from point A to point B into Harden's (LAC) body, affecting his driving shot attempt.

Booker (PHX) lowers his right arm naturally to pursue the rebound and there is contact to Jones Jr.'s (LAC) face. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Dunn (PHX) moves laterally into Harden (LAC), initiating body contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Jones Jr. (LAC) initiates contact to Booker's (PHX) arm that causes him to lose his balance.
Harden (LAC) commits a take foul on O'Neale (PHX).
Batum (LAC) commits a take foul on Booker (PHX).
Jones Jr. (LAC) makes more than marginal contact with Booker's (PHX) arms as he reaches for the ball.
Batum (LAC) commits a take foul on Booker (PHX).
